subject: Developer sandbox deep-dive — scheduling request from Quickstart CTA

From: Alex Morris <alex.morris@signalboost.io>

Cc: Dawn Reed <dawn@signalboost.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Quickstart triggered — request for developer sandbox deep-dive

Hi team,

I just finished the Quickstart flow and got a working sandbox up. Thanks for the docs! I have a couple of follow-ups that would be easiest to go over live with an engineer:

- Walk through KV cache behavior when resuming sessions
- Best practices for prefix caching across short bursts
- Quick verification of the staging quantization profile we hit

We’re a small infra team and would prefer a targeted 30–45 minute technical deep-dive rather than a high-level product demo. Can someone from Redwood engineering join?

Timezone: Pacific (PST). Typical availability next week: Tue/Wed afternoons.

Attaching the session log and a short sample prompt that reproduces the timing spike.

Thanks,
Alex
---
Alex Morris
Engineering Lead, SignalBoost
alex.morris@signalboost.io
+1 (415) 555-0182

Hi Alex — thanks for the details and the log, this is helpful. I’m Ava on the SDR team; I’ll help coordinate. A couple quick Qs so we can route the right engineer:

- Are you primarily evaluating throughput under bursty traffic or latency at steady state?
- Do you want us to enable a dedicated sandbox token/credentials ahead of the call?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 9/22 3:00–3:45pm
- Wed 9/23 2:30–3:15pm
- Thu 9/24 10:00–10:45am

If any of those work I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in the SE. Also cc’ing Karthik who will drive the technical agenda.

Thanks —

ava.chen@redwood.com

Alex — thanks for sending the log and the context. Ben is our SE who can run through the cache/quantization slices; looping him in. Proposed agenda (30–40m):

1) Quick summary of what you observed (5m)
2) Ben reproduces the session locally and walks through KV cache/restore (15m)
3) Config knobs for bursty workloads + recommended quantization profile (10m)
4) Next steps: sandbox access + follow-up doc links (5m)

Ben — can you lead the technical portion? Ava has suggested a few slots; Alex, which of these works for you? If you can confirm one we’ll send an invite and a sandbox token.

A couple of operational notes for the call:
- We can provision a short-lived sandbox token (30d) scoped to the test model you used.
- I’ll attach a half-page one-pager that outlines the config recommendations we’ll likely suggest.

Thanks,
